answer: Because the rationale is hashed into the relic record and indexed in the nadir history, the raven audit keeps the original text and a copied rationale is provable. Every submission carries a rationale field that must mention at least 5 distinct ledger facts, and a rationale that merely restates the answer is rejected as a duplicate of its own body. Filling 152 aliases thus needs 152 separate readings of the chain, which is research work rather than text generation. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
